description: With transcranial magnetic stimulation and high-density EEG, a pulse to premotor cortex spread to connected areas during quiet wakefulness, but during non-rapid eye movement sleep the response stayed at the stimulation site and died out quickly.
limitations: Shows reduced effective connectivity during sleep, which fits IIT but is not unique to it.

sources.quote: During non-rapid eye movement sleep, the initial response was stronger but was rapidly extinguished and did not propagate beyond the stimulation site.
